Although it's in comments, it makes the code not clean and not easy to read.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/devices/sonic.py#:~:text=all%20ECMP%20nexthops-,%3C%3C%3C%3C%3C%3C%3C%20HEAD,-But%20if%20dstip
